<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-24. -->
## YouTube and YouTube Music

- **Glass menus:** On Android 12 or newer with system window blur enabled, turn on **RVX → General → Glass menus** to frost supported menus. Adjust panel opacity, blur and background dimming separately. The option is off by default and independent of the glass navigation bar and miniplayer. (#76)
- **App icons:** Choose which icon packs to include at patch time. Only those packs appear in the in-app **App icon** picker; all are included by default. The new **ReVanced** and **Reseam** packs change the launcher icon without changing the header or splash screen. (#77)

## YouTube

- **Offline downloads:** The built-in RVX player now uses your playback speeds, double-tap seek intervals, swipe controls, fullscreen preference, overlay opacity, seekbar colors and repeat controls. Downloads also open in this player if the network is connected but YouTube is unreachable. This does not add YouTube’s native downloads. (#84)
- **Home feed:** **Show channel names on Home** now works with the **Classic** feed card layout when the card identifies the channel. (#83)
- **Seek previews:** Enable **Hide old seekbar thumbnail border** to remove the white frame from old-style previews without changing their size or position. (#71)

## YouTube Music

- **Third-party lyrics:** Repeated lines highlight one at a time at their own timestamps, including when word sync or separate background vocals are enabled. (#85)

Refresh the RVX patch source in Manager, then repatch and install the app you use.
